title: Fourier formula for each support component
statement:
Let $g$ be the indicator of $c$ on the equally weighted set $\{a,b,c\}$, with Fourier coefficients $\widehat g(0)=1/3$, $\widehat g(1)=-\sqrt2/6$, and $\widehat g(2)=-\sqrt6/6$. For any subset $S\subseteq\{0,1\}$, the Fourier component of $(x_0,x_1)\mapsto g(x_0)g(x_1)$ supported on $S$ is the sum, over pairs of indices $(a_0,a_1)\in\{0,1,2\}^2$ whose nonzero-index coordinates are exactly $S$, of
\[\widehat g(a_0)\widehat g(a_1)\,\phi_{a_0}(x_0)\phi_{a_1}(x_1),\]
where $\phi_0,\phi_1,\phi_2$ are the three-point orthonormal Fourier basis functions.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the two coordinate positions
